concerns.text: T012b (Dataset Block Check) is ordered BEFORE T013 (Filtering), but T012b explicitly forbids the 'synthetic proxy fallback' required by plan.md (Phase 0) and spec.md (Assumptions) to handle dataset unavailability. If the dataset is missing, T012b aborts the pipeline, preventing T013 from ever running. This creates a fatal ordering/logic violation where the 'Foundational' phase blocks the 'Data Preparation' phase from executing its required fallback logic, violating the data-flow dependency for reproducibility.

T026a (Monolithic Runner) and T026b (Dual-Track Runner) depend on T013b (Model Fetch). However, T013b is marked [P] (parallel-safe) and placed in Phase 4, while T026a/T026b are also in Phase 4. If T013b runs in parallel with T026a, T026a may attempt to load the model before T013b has finished downloading it. The task description for T026a lists T013b as a dependency, but the [P] tag on T013b and the lack of explicit sequential ordering within Phase 4 creates a race condition where the consumer (Runner) may start before the producer (Fetcher) completes.

T033 (Human Annotation Selection) and T033b (Ground Truth Generation) are placed in Phase 5, but T034 (Comparison) and T034b (Exclusion Validation) depend on T033b. However, T034 and T034b also depend on T026f (Merged Logs). T026f is in Phase 4. The ordering implies Phase 5 tasks can start only after Phase 4 is complete. However, T033 (Selection) depends on T013 (Filtered Tasks) from Phase 3. The current grouping forces T033 to wait until Phase 5, creating an unnecessary delay in the data-flow. More critically, T033b (Ground Truth) is a prerequisite for T034/T034b, but T033b is listed as a separate task in Phase 5. If T033 and T033b are not strictly ordered (T033 -> T033b), T033b might run before the sample is selected. The text says 'Run AFTER T033', but the [P] tag on T033 (if implied by grouping) or lack of explicit dependency chain in the Phase 5 list risks T033b running before T033 completes.

T022 (Resolver) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T021 (Constraint Store). T021 is also in Phase 4. While the text says 'Run AFTER T021', the [P] tag on T022 is misleading if it implies it can run in parallel with T021. The tag should be removed or the dependency made explicit in the task header to avoid confusion about parallel execution safety.
